body:
One more case I found while checking this, and I think it's the most likely one to hit in a real app: a reference that shadows the field used in a two-way binding.

```html
<input name="email" #email="ngModel" [(ngModel)]="email" />
```

with `email = ''` on the component. This builds without any error with the CLI, with `strictTemplates` on too. At runtime the input shows `[object Object]`, because `[ngModel]` ends up bound to the `NgModel` directive itself, and typing never updates `email`. Nothing is logged either. The generated listener only calls `ɵɵtwoWayBindingSet(email_r2, $event)`, so unlike the click case, esbuild has no assignment to complain about.

The two-way check in the template semantics checker only looks at template variables and `@let` declarations, so references go through there as well.
